hero.oneLiner: CP Capital Limited positions itself as a secured, conservatively-leveraged NBFC lender, emphasising high collateral coverage on stressed assets and a diversified loan book spanning property-backed, unsecured MSME, and trade-finance products.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body: - 99.90% of gross NPA is secured, backed by collateral valued at ₹87.7 Cr against ₹35.17 Cr of secured NPA, a coverage of approximately 2.5x, underscoring an asset-quality-first, secured-lending stance.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body: - Debt-to-Equity (Borrowings/Equity) improved from 0.16x (31 Mar 2026) to 0.14x (30 Jun 2026), described by the company as a conservative capital structure providing continued headroom to scale the loan book through incremental borrowing.
